reasoning: US midterm elections are constitutionally mandated and have occurred on schedule throughout American history, including during wars, pandemics, and other crises. The 2026 midterms are scheduled for November 3, 2026. There is no constitutional mechanism for a president to cancel or postpone federal elections - this power rests with Congress, which has never exercised it to delay a general election. While there may be political tensions, the institutional barriers to canceling elections are extremely high. Even during COVID-19, the 2020 elections proceeded. The probability of disruption is very low.
